M14Requirement.actualConfirmedRule: **待处理请求统一在输入框位置**：命令审批、Agent 提问、插件业务审批、M12 跨任务网页授权、子任务的请求用同一种面板——标题与来源、必要详情、带编号选项（数字键选择、Enter 确认）、可写原因；多个请求时 1／N 切换；命令审批不提供“拒绝并停止本轮”。邮件审阅正文及手动修改放在时间线，底部是批准发送、手动修改、让 Agent 按说明修改和拒绝的请求操作。跨任务网页授权在同一请求面板显示目标任务名称、页面地址和观察／控制的权限说明。不在页面里做通知卡片；窗口在后台时用系统通知提醒（设置可关）。交互式任务的请求不设界面超时，一直等待用户处理，Agent 在等待期间可以先做别的事；批准时宿主重新校验内容、账号和当前授权。业务等待写入资格时，用户可停止任务或撤销批准。取得资格后重新校验并开始计算执行时限；任何等待（排队、父任务排空、依赖安装等）都不计入，执行时限一律从宿主放行业务执行的时刻起算（2026-11-18 用户确认，技术方案 §8.1）。**修改 M12 R06.3 的“60 秒无人处理按拒绝”，仅对交互式任务**；无人值守的跨任务网页新授权仍默认拒绝。2026-11-25：普通定时任务的其他权限及审批按[M16 F16-R06](../M16_定时任务/需求.md)，不泛化跨任务规则。

M12HistoricRequirement.R06.3: Original user-approved same-project legacy request had 60s deadline and run-scoped grants; current M14 expressly revised ordinary request presentation and timeout.

facts: Normal current native bound-run browser access request is accepted by durable host-business request and appears in the unified input-area panel.
Normal current interactive requests have no original 60-second UI deadline; host rechecks real task/project/page/mode at user decision and bind.
Current observe request cannot be elevated to control in the decision; no unauthorized control or synthetic state injection.

Legacy no-bound-run fallback exists in source but has not been demonstrated as a normal current two-fresh-native-task path; cannot force missing binding, resurrect old PTY or bypass the current authorization workflow.

Current grants panel is a real UI listing current actually bound run grants. To match original populated control row requires a new explicit legitimate control request and actual user approval for the exact same project / target / active run; existing historical observe approval or advanced pending approval is not a current control grant.
